description.p: File Flier is a fast file manager built for the keyboard. Start typing to filter a folder instantly, jump anywhere with the command palette, and work in tabs and split panes.

ul.li: Tabs and split panes, with drag-and-drop between them
Details, list and thumbnail grid views
Instant type-to-filter and recursive fuzzy search
Command palette and a Go To box with path completion
Finder-style preview panel with zoom, for photos (including HEIC and camera RAW), PDFs, office documents, video, audio and more
Bookmarks, recent folders, drives and network shares in the sidebar
Eight themes, custom accent colors, adjustable size and an optional frosted glass style
Quick Look previews, inline rename and undo
Compress and extract archives, Open With, a trash browser, and drive mounting and ejecting
Copy, paste and drag files to and from other apps
Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox, with sign-in in your browser
Previews of 3D models and 3D-printer G-code

screenshot.caption: Split panes with a thumbnail grid and the inspector
Searchable context menu with keyboard shortcuts

ul.li: Sign in to Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox from the sidebar; you log in on the provider's own page in your browser
Cloud and network drives show a usage bar with free and total space
Previews of 3D models (STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF) that you can turn, with size, volume and triangle count
3D-printer G-code shows the slicer's thumbnail and print time, filament, material and layer height
File Flier can check GitHub for new versions and update itself (can be turned off in Settings)
The Inter typeface is now built in, with semibold headings
Colorful file icons by type: PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, images, audio, video, archives, code and more
A deeper dark theme with brighter text and a vivid accent color
The active tab and current sidebar location are marked with the accent color
Folders with only hidden files say so, and how to show them
Replace, Keep Both or Skip when a pasted name already exists; replaced items go to the trash
Compress to ZIP and Extract Here (ZIP, tar, 7z, RAR and more)
Open With any installed app, and set the default app for a file type
Browse the trash: restore, delete forever or empty it
Mount drives from the sidebar and safely eject USB drives
Copy files to the clipboard as real files and drag them into other apps
Move to Trash and Delete are shown in red in right-click menus
A Finder-style preview panel with a large zoomable preview and detailed file information
HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, SVG, camera RAW, TIFF and many more image formats, with camera details
PDF pages, and Word, OpenDocument, RTF and PowerPoint documents (real pages when LibreOffice is installed)
Spreadsheets as tables, video frames, album art, archive contents, fonts and highlighted code
Thumbnails for all of these in grid view, shared with other file managers
The disk space bar in the sidebar now shows your home drive, and works inside Flatpak
Hover a drive to see how much space is free
Clearer instructions for enabling "Open terminal here", and an error when no terminal app is found
Quick Look: press Space for a large preview and browse with the arrow keys
Rename files in place with F2
Undo (Ctrl+Z) for renames, moves, copies, new items and moving to the trash
Optional frosted glass style, with desktop blur on KDE Plasma and macOS
Smooth animations throughout, which can be turned off
AppImage mounts no longer show up as drives
New Settings window (Ctrl+,)
Eight themes: File Pilot Dark, Light, Midnight, Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin Mocha, Gruvbox and Solarized Light
Custom accent colors, interface size and row density
Relative or friendly date formats
Option to restore your tabs from last time
